title: Salesforce Account Brief
prompt: Prepare a short account brief for the matching Northwind account records. Summarize segment and service context, and flag missing fields instead of filling them by inference.
instructions: Run only the supplied read-only Account search condition and summarize the returned sample. Keep records separate if names are similar; do not update Salesforce, send email, or claim a full CRM search beyond the response. Treat account facts as synthetic and cite the account record URL.
fixture_summary: Synthetic Salesforce search returns three matching account records: one enterprise account with a renewal concern, one subsidiary, and one historical duplicate candidate.
